name: cyberpunk-rain-scene
title: Neon Rain Metropolis
description: A layered cyberpunk skyline in the rain: glowing katakana holograms, wet street reflections and diagonal rain streaks, with pointer parallax across the depth layers.

name: black-hole-scene
title: Gargantua Accretion Disk
description: A black hole bending the starfield behind it: a lensed accretion disk, a Doppler-shifted photon ring and swirling infalling matter.

name: synthwave-horizon-scene
title: Outrun Wireframe Horizon
description: Scrolling wireframe mountains under a segmented retro sun, with starlight and scanlines over a perspective grid.

name: coastal-lighthouse-scene
title: Midnight Lighthouse & Storm Swell
description: A lighthouse beam sweeping through fog over a breaking procedural sea and dark cliffs.

name: terminal-deck-scene
title: Retro CRT Cyberdeck OS
description: A live multi-pane terminal console: a rotating wireframe satellite, a scrolling hex dump, a waveform scope and system diagnostics.

name: sacred-torus-scene
title: Sacred Geometry Torus Knot
description: A z-buffered 3D p-q torus knot and morphing polyhedra, shaded with directional edge glyphs.

name: matrix-cathedral-scene
title: Digital Rain Vault
description: Perspective columns built from falling half-width katakana and hex streams, fading into depth fog.

name: campfire-woods-scene
title: Ember Woods & Fireflies
description: A campfire's rising flame and drifting sparks among pine silhouettes, with softly pulsing fireflies.

name: warp-tunnel-scene
title: Relativistic Starfield Tunnel
description: A high-speed wormhole of radially streaking glyphs, with a vanishing point you steer with the pointer.

name: abyssal-jellyfish-scene
title: Bioluminescent Abyss Aquarium
description: Jellyfish drifting with sine-driven tentacles, rising bubbles and caustic light rays in the deep.

name: tempest-storm-scene
title: Procedural Lightning & Cumulonimbus
description: Volumetric storm clouds split by branching fractal lightning, with screen-flash bloom and wind-driven rain.

name: fluid-smoke-scene
title: Interactive Curl-Noise Plume
description: A smoke and ink plume driven by curl noise that swirls around the pointer, drawn in Braille or dense ramps.
